decisions.explanation: The application allows setting an external static file location via a configuration method (Service.java:254) which, in many Spark Java deployments, can be influenced by attacker-controlled input (e.g., via system properties, environment variables, or configuration files if the app is compromised, or directly if the API is exposed). More critically, the path traversal occurs in the resource loading logic: AbstractResourceHandler.addPaths (AbstractResourceHandler.java:103) concatenates paths without sanitizing '../' sequences. When JarResourceHandler.loadStream (JarResourceHandler.java:109) uses this path, it can escape the intended directory structure. Although the sink is getResourceAsStream (typically for classpath resources), if the base path is set to an external directory or if the implementation allows accessing files outside the classpath via specific handlers, this constitutes a path traversal vulnerability.
